lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A transition from high-density, small-diameter clusters posterior to the gills into a regularized grid of larger, high-luminance circular nodes along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of blobs, creating a structured matrix of anchor nodes along the lateral line.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with highlights on the dorsal-facing edge and deep shadows on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs primarily concentrated along the anterior edge and the base of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A unique, non-linear 'swirl' or 'U-shaped' configuration of high-intensity spots is present on the mid-flank, posterior to the pectoral fin insertion, deviating from the standard grid pattern.
